subject: DI01005021

body.en:
Definition

A plastic is a polymer-based material formulated so it can be shaped during manufacture and retain a useful form in service.

Classification

  • Thermoplastics soften on heating and can generally be reshaped: PE, PP, PVC and suitable engineering polymers.
  • Thermosets form permanent crosslinked networks on curing: epoxy, phenolic and cured unsaturated polyester; reheating does not remelt them into a reusable liquid.

Properties and explanation

  • Low density, easy shaping, useful electrical insulation and often chemical resistance, but strong grade/temperature dependence.
  • Viscoelasticity, creep, ageing, UV exposure, flammability and relatively high expansion can limit use; thermoplastics are not all chemically equivalent.

Applications and selection

  • Compatible piping/linings, instrument housings and insulation; specify polymer, additives, mechanical load and temperature rather than selecting by colour.

Labelled diagram and explanation

Unlinked/weakly linked chains can flow on heating; dense permanent crosslinks make a thermoset. Light crosslinks support rubber recovery. The sketches simplify actual chain structure.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Plastic polymer-based પદાર્થ છે, જેને manufacture દરમિયાન આકાર આપી serviceમાં ઉપયોગી સ્વરૂપ જાળવી શકાય.

વર્ગીકરણ

  • Thermoplastic ગરમ કરતાં નરમ પડે અને સામાન્ય રીતે ફરી આકાર લઈ શકે: PE, PP, PVC તથા engineering polymers.
  • Thermoset curingથી permanent crosslinked network બનાવે: epoxy, phenolic, cured unsaturated polyester; ફરી ગરમ કરતાં ફરી વાપરી શકાય તેવું melt થતું નથી.

ગુણધર્મો તથા સમજણ

  • ઓછી density, સરળ shaping, ઉપયોગી electrical insulation અને ઘણી વાર chemical resistance; grade/temperature પર મોટો આધાર.
  • Viscoelasticity, creep, ageing, UV, flammability તથા વધુ expansion મર્યાદા લાવે; બધા thermoplastics chemical રીતે સમાન નથી.

ઉપયોગો તથા પસંદગી

  • અનુકૂળ piping/lining, instrument housing તથા insulation; માત્ર રંગથી નહીં, polymer, additives, ભાર તથા temperatureથી પસંદ કરો.

નામવાળી આકૃતિ અને સમજણ

સરળ/ઓછાં linked chains ગરમીમાં flow કરી શકે; ઘણા permanent crosslinksથી thermoset બને. હળવાં crosslinks rubber recoveryમાં મદદ કરે. વાસ્તવિક chainsનું સરળ ચિત્ર છે.

body.en:
Definition

Rubber is an elastomer capable of large, substantially recoverable deformation within its service limits.

Classification

  • Natural rubber: mainly cis-polyisoprene. Synthetic: SBR, NBR, EPDM, silicone and fluoroelastomers, among others.
  • Vulcanisation/crosslinking limits chain slippage and improves elastic recovery; crosslink chemistry varies and not every elastomer uses sulfur.

Properties and explanation

  • Flexible, resilient and vibration-damping; affected by temperature, ageing, swelling, compression set and chemical exposure.
  • NR has good elasticity but poor resistance to many oils; NBR often suits oils; EPDM often suits water/weather but not petroleum oils. Actual formulation governs limits.

Applications and selection

  • Seals, selected gaskets, hoses, vibration mounts and linings; compatibility must be verified for actual concentration and temperature.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Rubber એવો elastomer છે જે service limitsમાં વધુ વિકૃતિ લઈ મોટા ભાગે મૂળ આકારમાં પાછો આવી શકે.

વર્ગીકરણ

  • Natural rubber મુખ્યત્વે cis-polyisoprene. Syntheticમાં SBR, NBR, EPDM, silicone તથા fluoroelastomers.
  • Vulcanisation/crosslinking chain slip ઘટાડે અને elastic recovery સુધારે; દરેક elastomerમાં sulfur વપરાતું નથી.

ગુણધર્મો તથા સમજણ

  • Flexible, resilient અને vibration-damping; temperature, ageing, swelling, compression set તથા chemicalsથી અસર.
  • NRની elasticity સારી પણ ઘણા oils સામે નબળું; NBR ઘણી વાર oils માટે, EPDM water/weather માટે પણ petroleum oils માટે નહીં. Actual formulationની limits જુઓ.

ઉપયોગો તથા પસંદગી

  • Seal, પસંદ કરેલા gasket, hose, vibration mount તથા lining; actual concentration/temperature માટે compatibility ચકાસો.

body.en:
Definition

A fibre is a slender material element with length much greater than its transverse dimension, useful in textiles, reinforcement or insulation.

Classification

  • Natural: cotton/jute(cellulose), wool/silk(protein). Manufactured organic: regenerated cellulose and synthetic polyester/nylon.
  • Inorganic examples: glass and carbon fibres. Chemistry, filament length and intended role are separate classification bases.

Properties and explanation

  • High aspect ratio permits flexible yarn/mat or directional reinforcement; tensile strength, moisture uptake and heat/chemical resistance depend on fibre.
  • Composite strength depends on fibre alignment, matrix and bonding, not fibre strength alone; chopped and continuous fibres behave differently.

Applications and selection

  • Filter cloths, reinforcement, protective textiles and insulation in compatible service. Do not handle asbestos or uncontrolled respirable fibres.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Fibre એવો પાતળો તત્ત્વ છે જેની length તેના આડા માપ કરતાં ઘણી વધુ હોય; textile, reinforcement અથવા insulationમાં ઉપયોગી.

વર્ગીકરણ

  • Naturalમાં cotton/jute: cellulose; wool/silk: protein. Manufactured organicમાં regenerated cellulose તથા synthetic polyester/nylon.
  • Inorganicમાં glass તથા carbon fibres. Chemistry, filament length અને કામ જુદા classification આધાર છે.

ગુણધર્મો તથા સમજણ

  • મોટા aspect ratioથી flexible yarn/mat કે દિશાત્મક reinforcement બને. Strength, moisture uptake તથા heat/chemical resistance fibre પ્રમાણે બદલાય.
  • Composite strengthમાં alignment, matrix તથા bonding પણ મહત્વનાં; chopped/continuous fibreનું વર્તન જુદું.

ઉપયોગો તથા પસંદગી

  • અનુકૂળ filter cloth, reinforcement, protective textile તથા insulation. Asbestos કે અનિયંત્રિત respirable fibres ન હેન્ડલ કરો.

body.en:
Definition

Paint is a coating composition that forms an adherent protective/decorative film, usually containing a binder and pigments with a liquid carrier or another application medium.

Classification

  • By binder: alkyd, acrylic, epoxy, polyurethane, inorganic systems. By carrier: water-borne, solvent-borne or powder; by service: anticorrosive, decorative or special-duty. These axes overlap.

Composition

  • Binder forms the continuous film and adhesion; pigments give colour/opacity and may provide special protection.
  • Extenders modify film/body and cost; solvent/water adjusts application; additives control dispersion, flow, drying and storage. Not every coating contains every ingredient.

Properties and explanation

  • Good adhesion, appropriate chemical/weather resistance, coverage, drying/curing, flexibility and durable film are required for the service. Surface preparation and cure quality matter.

Applications and selection

  • Protect steel structures/equipment exteriors and identify surfaces. A primer/intermediate/topcoat system has different layer functions.

Limitations and precautions

  • Do not prescribe paint mixing, solvent handling or isocyanate spraying for students. A coating is not a substitute for a sound pressure boundary.

Labelled diagram and explanation

The primer bonds to the prepared substrate; intermediate coat builds protection and topcoat faces the surroundings. Layer roles depend on the specified coating system.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Paint એવી coating રચના છે જે ચોંટેલો protective/decorative film બનાવે; સામાન્ય રીતે binder, pigment અને liquid carrier અથવા અન્ય application medium હોય.

વર્ગીકરણ

  • Binder પ્રમાણે alkyd, acrylic, epoxy, polyurethane, inorganic; carrier પ્રમાણે water-borne, solvent-borne, powder; service પ્રમાણે anticorrosive, decorative, special-duty. આ આધાર એકબીજાથી જુદા છે.

રચના / ઘટકો

  • Binder સતત film તથા adhesion આપે; pigments રંગ/opacity અને કેટલીકવાર ખાસ protection આપે.
  • Extenders body/film તથા cost બદલે; solvent/water application અનુકૂળ કરે; additives dispersion, flow, drying/storage સુધારે. દરેક coatingમાં બધાં ingredients હોય જ નહીં.

ગુણધર્મો તથા સમજણ

  • Service મુજબ સારી adhesion, chemical/weather resistance, coverage, drying/curing, flexibility તથા durable film જોઈએ. Surface preparation/cure ખૂબ મહત્વનાં.

ઉપયોગો તથા પસંદગી

  • Steel structures/equipmentની બહારની સપાટી બચાવવા તથા ઓળખ માટે; primer/intermediate/topcoatનાં કામ જુદાં.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા સાવચેતી

  • Studentને paint mixing, solvent handling કે isocyanate spraying કરાવવું નહીં. Coating મજબૂત pressure boundaryનો વિકલ્પ નથી.

નામવાળી આકૃતિ અને સમજણ

Primer તૈયાર substrateને ચોંટે; intermediate protection વધારે, topcoat બહારના વાતાવરણ સામે રહે. ચોક્કસ coating system પ્રમાણે કામ બદલાય.

body.en:
Definition

Varnish is a usually transparent or translucent film-forming protective finish, conventionally without the opaque pigment loading of paint.

Classification

  • Traditional: oil varnish and spirit varnish; modern binder families include acrylic, polyurethane and epoxy systems. Water/solvent carrier is a separate basis.

Composition

  • Film-forming resin/binder plus suitable carrier and additives; traditional oil varnishes contain drying oil/resin, while spirit varnish contains a suitable resin in a volatile solvent. Formulations differ.

Properties and explanation

  • Clear appearance, adhesion, film hardness with suitable flexibility, drying/curing and service-specific moisture/chemical/weather resistance. Transparent does not mean universally UV-stable.

Applications and selection

  • Wood finishes, selected protective clear coatings and specified electrical insulating varnishes. Compare paint’s hiding power with varnish’s visibility of the substrate.

Limitations and precautions

  • Solvents and curing agents may be hazardous; choose the exact product/system rather than assuming all varnish provides chemical-plant corrosion protection.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Varnish સામાન્ય રીતે transparent/translucent protective film બનાવે; paint જેવી opaque pigmentની માત્રા સામાન્ય રીતે નથી.

વર્ગીકરણ

  • પરંપરાગત oil varnish અને spirit varnish; આધુનિક binderમાં acrylic, polyurethane, epoxy. Water/solvent carrier જુદો આધાર છે.

રચના / ઘટકો

  • Film-forming resin/binder, યોગ્ય carrier તથા additives; traditional oil varnishમાં drying oil/resin, spirit varnishમાં volatile solventમાં યોગ્ય resin. Formulations જુદી હોય.

ગુણધર્મો તથા સમજણ

  • Clear appearance, adhesion, યોગ્ય flexibility સાથે film hardness, drying/curing તથા service મુજબ moisture/chemical/weather resistance. Transparent એટલે હંમેશાં UV-stable નહીં.

ઉપયોગો તથા પસંદગી

  • Wood finish, selected clear protective coating તથા specified electrical insulating varnish. Paint સપાટી ઢાંકે; varnishમાં મૂળ સપાટી દેખાય.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા સાવચેતી

  • Solvent/curing agents જોખમી હોઈ શકે; બધા varnishથી chemical-plant corrosion protection મળે એવું ન માનો.

body.en:
Definition

A gasket is a deformable sealing element compressed between stationary mating surfaces to limit leakage.

Classification

  • Non-metallic: elastomer, PTFE, flexible graphite and approved compressed-fibre materials.
  • Semi-metallic: spiral-wound and jacketed gaskets. Metallic: ring-type joint or other engineered metal seals. Asbestos is not recommended.

Labelled diagram and explanation

3 bolts compress2gasket between1flanges around4bore. The liquid path is through the bore, not through the gasket; the diagram gives no bolt torque.

Construction / labelled parts

  • 1 two flange faces, 2 gasket between sealing faces, 3 bolts provide designed compression, 4 fluid bore; material and geometry must match the specified flange.

Properties and explanation

  • Sealability depends on contact stress, resilience, creep/relaxation, surface finish and chemical/temperature compatibility.
  • PTFE offers broad compatibility but creeps; graphite handles selected hot services but oxidation matters; elastomer suitability is fluid-specific.

Applications and selection

  • Flanged piping, vessel covers and heat exchangers. Select by fluid, temperature, pressure, flange type and the approved bolting design—not by thickness alone.

Limitations and precautions

  • No tightening under pressure, improvised gasket cutting for hazardous service or generic torque is authorised. Isolate, drain and verify zero energy before approved maintenance.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

બે સ્થિર જોડાતી સપાટી વચ્ચે દબાઈ leakage મર્યાદિત કરતો deformable sealing element gasket છે.

વર્ગીકરણ

  • Non-metallicમાં elastomer, PTFE, flexible graphite તથા approved compressed-fibre.
  • Semi-metallicમાં spiral-wound, jacketed; metallicમાં ring-type joint તથા engineered metal seals. Asbestos ભલામણ નથી.

નામવાળી આકૃતિ અને સમજણ

3 boltsથી 1 flanges વચ્ચે 2 gasket દબાય; 4 boreમાંથી liquid જાય, gasketમાંથી નહીં. Drawingમાં bolt torque નથી.

રચના / દર્શાવેલા ભાગો

  • 1 બે flange faces, 2 વચ્ચે gasket, 3 boltsથી designed compression, 4 fluid bore; material/geometry specified flange સાથે મેળ ખાતાં જોઈએ.

ગુણધર્મો તથા સમજણ

  • Contact stress, resilience, creep/relaxation, surface finish અને chemical/temperature compatibilityથી sealing નક્કી થાય.
  • PTFEની compatibility વ્યાપક પણ creep થાય; graphite પસંદ કરેલી ગરમ serviceમાં ઉપયોગી પણ oxidation મહત્વનું; elastomer fluid-specific છે.

ઉપયોગો તથા પસંદગી

  • Flanged piping, vessel cover, heat exchanger. Fluid, temperature, pressure, flange type તથા approved bolting designથી પસંદ કરો; માત્ર જાડાઈથી નહીં.

મર્યાદાઓ તથા સાવચેતી

  • Pressure હેઠળ tightening, hazardous serviceમાં improvised gasket cutting કે generic torque મંજૂર નથી. Approved maintenance પહેલાં isolate, drain અને verified zero energy જોઈએ.

body.en:
1. Write the exact fluid, concentration, continuous/transient temperature and mechanical conditions.
  2. Identify candidate polymer/elastomer/coating/gasket family; check exact grade, compatibility, creep, ageing and fire limits.
  3. Record the manufacturer/standard evidence and unresolved questions.
  4. Do not install, test a live flange, mix coatings or fabricate a chemical-service seal for this study exercise.
body.gu:
1. ચોક્કસ fluid, concentration, continuous/transient temperature તથા mechanical conditions લખો.
  2. Candidate family પછી exact grade, compatibility, creep, ageing અને fire limits તપાસો.
  3. Manufacturer/standard evidence તથા બાકી પ્રશ્નો નોંધો.
  4. આ અભ્યાસ માટે live flange test, installation, coating mixing કે chemical-service seal બનાવવું નહીં.

Choose only one of the five source-suggested projects. Group 3–5; about 16engagement hours/student; integrate at least two COs. Keep a dated individual diary and give a seminar before submission. Report format is agreed with the teacher. Planned only, no fabricated evidence.

  1. Arrange a chart by metals/alloys, ceramics/glass, polymers/elastomers, fibres and insulation.
  2. For each chosen example show identity, a key property with units and a realistic chemical-plant use.
  3. Add a legend distinguishing an element, an alloy and a composite; connect selection to at least two course outcomes.
body.gu:
પાંચ source-suggested projectsમાંથી માત્ર એક પસંદ કરો. Group 3–5; દરેકના લગભગ16engagement hours; ઓછામાં ઓછાં બે COs જોડો. Dated individual diary તથા submission પહેલાં seminar જરૂરી. Report format teacher સાથે નક્કી કરો. માત્ર આયોજન, બનાવટી evidence નહીં.

  1. Chartને metals/alloys, ceramics/glass, polymers/elastomers, fibres તથા insulationમાં ગોઠવો.
  2. પસંદ કરેલા ઉદાહરણની ઓળખ, એકમ સાથે મુખ્ય ગુણધર્મ તથા વાસ્તવિક chemical-plant use લખો.
  3. Element, alloy, composite જુદાં બતાવતો legend; ઓછામાં ઓછાં બે course outcomes જોડો.

body.en:
Choose only one of the five source-suggested projects. Group 3–5; about 16engagement hours/student; integrate at least two COs. Keep a dated individual diary and give a seminar before submission. Report format is agreed with the teacher. Planned only, no fabricated evidence.

  1. Agree the material list with the teacher and create an indexed information file, not an unverified sample collection.
  2. Each entry records name, family, grade/composition, properties, uses, limitations and traceable references.
  3. Cross-index by service need:conductivity, light weight, corrosion resistance, insulation or sealing; state unresolved compatibility questions.

body.en:
Choose only one of the five source-suggested projects. Group 3–5; about 16engagement hours/student; integrate at least two COs. Keep a dated individual diary and give a seminar before submission. Report format is agreed with the teacher. Planned only, no fabricated evidence.

  1. Use chart columns:material/type/characteristics/composition/physical property with units/application/limitation/source.
  2. Compare materials for one stated service; do not compare properties measured at incompatible temperatures.
  3. Use a consistent colour legend and readable units; leave unverified data blank rather than inventing values.

પાંચ source-suggested projectsમાંથી માત્ર એક પસંદ કરો. Group 3–5; દરેકના લગભગ16engagement hours; ઓછામાં ઓછાં બે COs જોડો. Dated individual diary તથા submission પહેલાં seminar જરૂરી. Report format teacher સાથે નક્કી કરો. માત્ર આયોજન, બનાવટી evidence નહીં.

  1. Chart columns:material, type, લક્ષણો, composition, એકમવાળી physical property, application, limit, source.
  2. એક નિર્ધારિત service માટે materials સરખાવો; અસમાન temperaturesનાં data સીધાં ન સરખાવો.
  3. સમાન colour legend તથા સ્પષ્ટ units; અચકાસેલું data બનાવવાને બદલે blank રાખો.

body.en: Thermoplastic ≠ thermoset; rubber compatibility is grade-specific; gasket selection needs fluid, T, P and flange design.
body.gu: Thermoplastic અને thermoset જુદાં; rubberની compatibility grade-specific; gasketમાં fluid, T, P તથા flange design તપાસો.

q.en: Can thermosets be remelted like thermoplastics?

a.en: No; the permanent network tends to degrade rather than flow into a reusable melt.
a.gu: ના; permanent network ફરી ઉપયોગી meltને બદલે degrade થાય.

q.en: Does transparent varnish contain paint-level opaque pigment?

a.en: Conventionally no; it forms a clear/translucent film so the substrate remains visible.
a.gu: સામાન્ય રીતે નહીં; clear/translucent filmથી મૂળ સપાટી દેખાય.

q.en: Is one rubber suitable for all fluids?
q.gu: એક Rubber બધા Fluids માટે યોગ્ય?

a.en: No; NR, NBR, EPDM and other grades differ greatly in swelling, temperature and chemical compatibility.
a.gu: ના; NR, NBR, EPDM વગેરેમાં swelling, temperature તથા chemical compatibility ખૂબ જુદી.

a.en: Suitable contact stress from designed bolting plus compatible material, surface finish and resilience; not merely thickness.
a.gu: Designed boltingથી યોગ્ય contact stress, compatible material, surface finish અને resilience; માત્ર thickness નહીં.

q.en: Define and classify plastics with properties, uses and limits.
q.gu: Plasticsની વ્યાખ્યા, વર્ગીકરણ, ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો લખો.

q.en: Explain rubber and fibres with classification and applications.
q.gu: Rubber તથા Fibresનું વર્ગીકરણ અને ઉપયોગો સમજાવો.

q.en: Classify paints and explain ingredients and functions.
q.gu: Paintsનું વર્ગીકરણ તથા Ingredientsનાં કામ સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain varnish properties, classification, ingredients and uses.
q.gu: Varnishના Properties, Classification, Ingredients તથા Uses સમજાવો.

q.en: Classify gaskets and explain suitable selection/uses.
q.gu: Gasketsનું વર્ગીકરણ તથા યોગ્ય Selection/Uses સમજાવો.
